verdicts_or_reports.expected: Applying a category and confirming the entry creates exactly one expense and clears the entry state.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Category application saves an expense while leaving the amount active. Confirming the category text then saves the same amount again. Reproduced with Food 0.55 and Transport 2; history shows two Transport €2 rows and Total: €4.
steps: Enter an amount on the main number pad (reproduced with 0.55 and 2).
Tap a category chip to apply Food or Transport.
The amount remains visible; tap the selected category chip to open its text field.
Tap the confirmation button beside the category text.
Swipe down to expense history; two entries were created for the one amount.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Back dismisses the calculation dialog and returns to Minus.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Back exits Minus to the Android launcher instead of dismissing the calculation dialog. Reproduced twice, in USD and EUR.
steps: Tap the Today budget pill on the main screen.
Tap Calculated amount / Tap for the full breakdown.
Observe the Android launcher instead of the app.
